title: Singapore T-bill auction results
description: Every MAS auction of 6-month and 1-year Singapore Treasury bills since May 1987: the cut-off yield and price, the yield on the cash you actually pay, the median and average yields, the amount sold, total bids and how much of each kind of bid was filled.
question: What yield did each 6-month and 1-year T-bill auction give, since 1987?

fields.name: auction_date
fields.meaning: The day the auction closed and the result was published.

fields.name: issue_code
fields.meaning: MAS's issue code, the code you apply for at a bank or ATM.

fields.name: issue_date
fields.meaning: The day the T-bill is issued and paid for.

fields.name: maturity_date
fields.meaning: The day it pays back its face value.

fields.name: cutoff_yield_pct
fields.meaning: The cut-off yield: the highest yield MAS accepted, which every successful bidder gets.

fields.name: cutoff_price_sgd_per_100
fields.unit: S$ per S$100 of face value
fields.meaning: What you pay for every S$100 you get back at maturity.

fields.name: yield_on_cash_paid_pct
fields.meaning: The return on the cash you actually pay (the discounted price), which is a little above the cut-off yield.

fields.name: median_yield_pct
fields.meaning: The median yield of the competitive bids that were accepted; MAS records none before November 2009.

fields.name: average_yield_pct
fields.meaning: The average yield of the competitive bids that were accepted.

fields.name: amount_sold_sgd_m
fields.meaning: How much MAS sold at the auction.

fields.name: bids_sgd_m
fields.meaning: How much was bid for in total.

fields.name: bid_to_cover
fields.meaning: Total bids divided by the amount sold: above 1 means more was asked for than was sold.

fields.name: non_competitive_filled_pct
fields.unit: percent of the amount asked for
fields.meaning: How much of each non-competitive bid (no yield named, the usual choice for individuals) was filled; none before the 27 Nov 2002 auction, the first where MAS records non-competitive bids allotted.

fields.name: competitive_at_cutoff_filled_pct
fields.unit: percent of the amount asked for
fields.meaning: How much of each competitive bid at exactly the cut-off yield was filled; bids at a lower yield were filled in full.

sources.terms: MAS Terms of Use of Datasets
